channel.title: News Talk 980 CKNW - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: At least 9 Toronto police officers arrested in organized crime investigation: sources
item.description: At least nine Toronto police officers have been arrested in connection with Project South, an organized crime and corruption investigation, sources tell Global News.

item.title: London Knights’ 3rd period comeback earns a point in 4-3 OT loss to Kitchener Rangers
item.description: London Knights erase a third period deficit to force overtime in 4-3 loss to Kitchener Rangers.

item.title: Where did the tips go? B.C. restaurants say thousands missing from third-party account
item.description: The president and CEO of the BC Restaurant & Foodservices Association said he has heard the same issues from restaurants all over the province.

item.title: Winnipeg Jets finish pre-Olympic schedule with 5-1 loss to Montreal
item.description: Kyle Connor opened the scoring for the Jets on the power play before Montreal scored five straight goals to pull away and drop Winnipeg to 22-26-8 entering the Olympic break.

item.title: Call of the Wilde: Canadiens head into Olympic break with 5-1 win over Winnipeg
item.description: The Montreal Canadiens have played 57 times and have lost in regulation only 17 games. As Brian Wilde explains, that's huge, and was on display against the Jets.

item.title: Edwards powers Timberwolves rally over Raptors
item.description: Anthony Edwards scored 30 points, with 21 coming in the second half, to help the Minnesota Timberwolves rally past the Toronto Raptors 128-126 on Wednesday.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie posts message to her mother’s kidnapper asking to provide proof she is alive
item.description: Guthrie said in a recorded video posted on social media that her family has heard media reports about a ransom letter for Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: Nanaimo tugboat owner frustrated with justice system after offender released
item.description: On Saturday, a man was caught on Andrew Reynold's security camera, illegally entering his tugboat, which was docked off Cameron Island.

item.title: The Curator: Viral skincare & makeup hacks that actually work
item.description: Beauty expert Christine Cho shares viral makeup tips actually worth trying, plus affordable, glow-boosting products from Covergirl, Maybelline, Rhode and more that make them work.

item.title: Flames take season series with 4-3 win over Oilers
item.description: Rookie Matvei Gridin had a goal and an assist for his first multi-point NHL game to lead the Calgary Flames to a 4-3 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday.
